verses.text: Ay jun winh skuchan Ananías, haxo ix yetb'eyum winh Safira sb'i ix. Ay jun sluum winh ix schonheli.

Ix schaan stojol jun sluum winh chi', palta ix yik'kanel nanhal yik winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi', yuj chi' manh tz'akanok stojol ayik xit' yak'ankan winh t'a heb' schekab' Jesús. Palta haxo ix aj yalan winh to tz'akan k'een tumin chi' smasanil. Yojtak pax ix yetb'eyum winh to icha chi' yaji.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Pedro t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj ix yak' a k'ool winh Satanás, yuj chi' tzesej t'a Yespíritu Dios? Ina ix ik'kanel nanhal k'een ik t'a stojol jun a lu'um chi'.

Ayik manto a chonh lu'um, yel ik lu'um. Hanhejtona' icha pax chi', ayik ix a chonhaneli, yel ik ton stojol chi'. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj ix a na jun chukal tik? Manhoklaj t'a heb' anima tzesej, palta a t'a Dios tzesej, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Ix lajwinhej yab'an jun chi' winhaj Ananías chi', ix ek' telnaj winh, ix cham winh. Haxo heb' ix ab'an spekal jun chi', ix te xiw heb'.
Haxo juntzanh heb' kelemtak ix jawi, ix sb'ak'anoch jun k'apak heb' t'a sniwanil winh. Ix yik'anelta winh heb', ix b'at smukankan winh heb'.
Ayxom oxeok hora scham winhaj Ananías chi', ix k'och ix yetb'eyum winh. Ix och ix t'a yol pat. Manh yojtakok ix tato ay tas ix ik'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro ix k'anb'an t'a ix: --Al t'ayin, ¿tom yel to icha tik ix he chonhb'at jun he lu'um chi'? xchi winh t'a ix. --I', ichaton chi', xchi ix t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a ix: --¿Tas yuj tze mol lajtiej he b'a yik tzeyak'an prowal Yespíritu Dios Kajal? Ina yajek' heb' winh ix xit' mukankan winh etb'eyum t'a ti' pat chi'. Haxo tiknaik ol ach yik'paxb'at heb' winh a ach tik, xchi winh t'a ix.

T'a jun rato chi', ix telwi ix t'a yichanh winhaj Pedro chi'. Ix cham ix. Haxo ix ochk'och heb' kelemtak chi', ix yilan heb' chamnakxo pax ix. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at ix heb'. Ix b'at smukanem ix heb' t'a stz'ey winh yetb'eyum chi'.
Yuj chi' ix xiwk'e heb' creyente smasanil yet' jantaknhej heb' ix ab'an spekal jun chi'.

Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús chi', tzijtum milagro ix sb'o heb'. Ix sch'ox wal el spoder Dios heb' t'a skal heb' anima. Ha t'a jun stentail stemplo Dios skuchan yik Salomón, hata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' creyente smasanil.
Haxo heb' manh creyenteok, malaj heb' stek'b'ej sb'a sk'ochi yik smolb'an sb'a heb' yet' heb'. Palta yojtak heb' to te wach' heb' creyente chi'.
Tzijtum heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool.

Tz'ik'jipaxelta heb' penaay t'a yoltak calle. Ay heb' tz'ik'jielta t'a sat ch'at, ay heb' t'a sat swaynub'. Hata' ix stanhwej heb' yek' winhaj Pedro, yik tope tzek' jab'ok yenhul winh t'a yib'anh heb' snaani.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix kot t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén. Ix yik'ankot juntzanh heb' penaay heb' yet' heb' tz'ixtax yuj heb' enemigo. Ix laj b'oxikan sk'ool heb' smasanil.
Haxo winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' yetb'eyum smasanil, haton heb' spartido heb' saduceo, ix te och chichonk'olal t'a spixan heb'.
Yuj chi' ix schek yamjok heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' heb'. Ix ak'jioch heb' winh t'a jun preso yik heb' chonhab'.
Haxo t'ak'walil ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix ul jakan te' preso chi'. Ix ik'jielta heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' winh:
--Ixikek t'a stemplo Dios. Tzex och t'a yol yamaq'uil. Tzex aj linhan ta', tzeyalanel wach' ab'ix yik k 'inal t'a junelnhej, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' toxo wan sakb'i ayik ix ochk'och heb' winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios chi', ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh ta'. Haxo winh sat sacerdote chi' yet' heb' winh yetb'eyum ix awtankot heb' winh sat yajal, haton jantaknhej heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' israel. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh polenkía heb', yik sb'at heb' winh yik'elta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a preso.
Haxo ix k'och heb' winh t'a te' preso chi', manhxalaj mach ayeq'ui. Ixlajwi yilan heb' winh to manhxalaj mach, ix b'at yalan heb' winh icha tik:
--Ix kila', wach' yajoch sk'ab' te' preso chi'. Haxo heb' stanhwumal te' chi', linhanek' heb' t'a sti' te'. Palta haxo ix ko jakan te', ix kilani manhxalaj mach ayek' t'a yol te', xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winh sat sacerdote chi', heb' yetb'eyum yet' pax winh yajal heb' winh stanhwumal stemplo Dios, ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix te sat sk'ool heb' winh. Maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh tas wal yaji.

Junanto rato chi' ix k'och junxo winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha heb' winh ix eyak'och t'a preso, ayxo ek' heb' winh t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios tiknaik. Wan sk'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', haxo winh yajal heb' stanhwan templo chi' yet' heb' winh polenkía, ix b'at heb' winh yik'kot heb' winh. Palta ak'ank'olal ix yutej heb' winh yik'ankot heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi', yujto ix xiw heb' winh sjulk'enaj yuj heb' anima.
Ix b'at ak'ji heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal. Haxo winh sat sacerdote chi' ix halan t'a heb' winh.

--Ina ix cham wal kalan t'ayex to maxtzak he k'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jesús. ¿Tom max he k'anab'ajej? Ha tiknaik, ix te pukaxb'at he k'ayb'ub'al t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto he gana tze ch'oxelta to a onh ix ko milcham Jesús chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Pedro yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh schekab' Jesús, ix yalan heb' winh: --Yowalil a tas syal Dios, a sko k'anab'ajej. Haxo juntzanh scheknab'il anima, tato max scha sb'a yet' yik Dios, max ko k'anab'ajejlaj.

Ha ex tik ix eyak' miljokcham Jesús, ayik ix t'unhb'ajk'e t'a te' kulus. Palta a jun Dios b'aj yak'nak em sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, hanheja' ko Diosal a onh tik. A' ix ak'an pitzwokxi Jesús chi' t'a skal heb' chamnak.
Ha ix ak'an yopisio, ix yik'anb'at t'a swach'k'ab'. Ix yak'anoch Kajalok yet' ko Kolumalok, yik wach' sko na ko b'a a onh israel onh tik, yik slajwikan ko mul yuj.

Ha onh tik, skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj juntzanh skal tik t'ayex. Hanhejtona' Yespíritu Dios syak' pax testigoal sb'a ket'ok. Ha Dios tz'ak'an Yespíritu tik t'a jantaknhej mach sk'anab'ajan tas syala', xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh yajal chi', ix te kot yowal heb' winh. Ix snib'ej heb' winh smilcham heb' winh t'a elanhchamel.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' winh yajal chi' ay jun winh fariseo skuch Gamaliel ayeq'ui. Te k'ayb'um winh t'a sley Dios. B'inajnak winh t'a wach'il yuj heb' anima. Ix k'e linhan winh. Ix schekan winh ik'jokkanelta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' junok rato.
Ixlajwi yelkankot heb' winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ex wetisraelal, naek wal sik'lab'il tas tzeyutej he b'oan yaj juntzanh heb' winh tik.

Ko naekkot jun winh skuch Teudas ek'nak t'a yalanhtaxo. Yak'nakoch sb'a winh yajalil t'a skal heb' anima. Yalannakel winh to te ay yopisio winh. Ay am junok chanhe' ciento winak ochnak yet' winh. Palta miljicham winh. Haxo jantak heb' ochnak yet' winh chi', saklemnakkanb'at heb'. Satnakpaxkanem jun yik heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun winh skuch Judas aj Galilea, yak'nakoch sb'a winh yak'an owal yet' heb' winh yajal ayik ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' anima. Tzijtum anima ochnak yet' winh. Hanheja' ix miljipaxcham junxo winh chi'. Haxo jantaknhej heb' ochnak yet' winh, saklemnakpaxkanb'at heb'.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, kaktejek kixtan heb' winh schekab' Jesús tik, yil heb' winh. Ha jun yik heb' winh tik, tato anhej heb' anima ay yiko', munil ol satxikanemok.
Palta tato ha Dios ay yiko', manh ol yal-laj kak'an lajwok. Ay smay to wan kak'an owal yet' Dios chi', xchi winh.

Ix snaan heb' winh yajal chi' to te yel syal winh. Yuj chi' ix awtajxioch heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' yuj heb' winh. Ix yalan heb' winh to smak'ji heb' winh. Ix yalanpax heb' winh t'a heb' winh to maxtzak yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix aktajel heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix elta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal. Te wach' ix yab' heb' winh, yujto yujnhej Jesús ix yab' syail heb' winh icha snib'ej Dios.
Masanil k'u ix yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh to Cristo toni, syalelk'ochi Jun Sik'b'ilel yuj Dios. Ix laj ek' yalel heb' winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yet' t'a kaltak pat.
